question.questionText: He was red in the face because he _______ for half an hour under the sun.
question.explanationHtml:
Detailed Explanation:
The blank needs a verb tense that shows an action that started in the past and continued up to a certain point in the past. The phrase 'for half an hour under the sun' indicates a duration, and the result is 'he was red in the face.' The correct tense to express an action that was happening over a period of time before another past event is the past perfect continuous (had been + V-ing).
  • are running (verb (present continuous)): 'Are running' is present continuous tense, used for actions happening now. It does not fit with the past context of the sentence.
  • ran (verb (simple past)): 'Ran' is the simple past tense, used for a completed action in the past. It does not emphasize the duration of the action.
  • had been running (verb (past perfect continuous)): 'Had been running' is the past perfect continuous tense, used to show an action that started in the past and continued up to another point in the past. It emphasizes the duration of the action.
  • was running (verb (past continuous)): 'Was running' is the past continuous tense, used for an action that was happening at a specific time in the past. It does not emphasize the duration up to another past event.
Related structure or vocabulary: Past perfect continuous tense: S + had been + V-ing + (for/since + time). Used to show an action that started in the past and continued up to another point in the past.

Giải thích chi tiết:
Chỗ trống cần một thì động từ diễn tả hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ và kéo dài đến một thời điểm khác trong quá khứ. Cụm 'for half an hour under the sun' chỉ khoảng thời gian, và kết quả là 'he was red in the face' (mặt anh ấy đỏ lên). Thì phù hợp để diễn tả hành động kéo dài trước một sự kiện khác trong quá khứ là quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn (had been + V-ing).
  • are running (động từ (hiện tại tiếp diễn)): 'Are running' là thì hiện tại tiếp diễn, dùng cho hành động đang xảy ra ở hiện tại. Không phù hợp với ngữ cảnh quá khứ của câu.
  • ran (động từ (quá khứ đơn)): 'Ran' là thì quá khứ đơn, dùng cho hành động đã hoàn thành trong quá khứ. Không nhấn mạnh vào khoảng thời gian diễn ra hành động.
  • had been running (động từ (quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn)): 'Had been running' là thì quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn, dùng để diễn tả hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ và kéo dài đến một thời điểm khác trong quá khứ. Nhấn mạnh vào khoảng thời gian diễn ra hành động.
  • was running (động từ (quá khứ tiếp diễn)): 'Was running' là thì quá khứ tiếp diễn, dùng cho hành động đang xảy ra tại một thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ. Không nhấn mạnh vào khoảng thời gian kéo dài đến một sự kiện khác trong quá khứ.
Cấu trúc và từ vựng: Thì quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn: S + had been + V-ing + (for/since + thời gian). Dùng để diễn tả hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ và kéo dài đến một thời điểm khác trong quá khứ.

question.questionText: It _______ and the road was covered in water.

The blank needs a verb tense that shows an action that happened before another past event. The sentence 'It _______ and the road was covered in water.' describes a situation where the road was already covered in water as a result of the rain. Therefore, we need to use the past perfect continuous tense (had been raining) to show that the rain started before and continued up to the time when the road was covered in water.
  • rained (verb (past simple)): Simple past tense. It describes a completed action in the past, but does not emphasize the duration or the result of the action.
  • had been raining (verb (past perfect continuous)): Past perfect continuous tense. It describes an action that started in the past and continued up to another point in the past. It emphasizes the duration and the result of the action.
  • is raining (verb (present continuous)): Present continuous tense. It describes an action happening right now, which does not fit with the past context of the sentence.
  • was raining (verb (past continuous)): Past continuous tense. It describes an action that was happening at a specific time in the past, but does not show that the action happened before another past event.
Related structure or vocabulary: Past perfect continuous tense: S + had been + V-ing. Used to show an action that started in the past and continued up to another point in the past.

question.questionText: I felt ill because I ________ six cups of coffee.

The sentence 'I felt ill because I ________ six cups of coffee.' requires a verb tense that shows an action completed before another action in the past. The action of drinking coffee happened before the feeling of being ill. The correct tense to use is the past perfect continuous (had been + V-ing) to emphasize the duration or repeated action in the past leading up to another past event.
  • has drunk (verb (present perfect)): 'Has drunk' is present perfect tense, used for actions that happened at an unspecified time before now. It is not suitable here because the sentence refers to two actions in the past.
  • had been drinking (verb (past perfect continuous)): 'Had been drinking' is past perfect continuous tense, used to show an action that was happening over a period of time before another action in the past. This fits the context because the drinking happened before feeling ill.
  • drunk (verb (past participle)): 'Drunk' is the past participle form of 'drink', but it cannot be used alone as the main verb in this sentence.
  • was drinking (verb (past continuous)): 'Was drinking' is past continuous tense, used for actions happening at a specific time in the past. It does not show that the action was completed before another past action.
Related structure or vocabulary: Past perfect continuous tense (had been + V-ing): used to show an action that was ongoing in the past before another past action.

  • had been drinking (động từ (quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn)): 'Had been drinking' là thì quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn, dùng để chỉ hành động đã diễn ra trong một khoảng thời gian trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ. Phù hợp với ngữ cảnh vì việc uống cà phê xảy ra trước khi cảm thấy không khỏe.
